levels.surface: الحارث بن محمد بن النعمان الأحول

notes: «عن أخيه علي» is one link with the name alone (rule 7); this «علي» is occurrence 2 of the word in the text.
«صاحب الطاق» is an epithet, left out; «الأحول» stays as the laqab.
The Imam «أبي عبد الله الصادق» follows «عن», so he is a narrator link (owner ruling 2). «آبائه» is a bare relation with no name.
The Prophet's words are the matn; the Prophet is not a link (rule 12).
